description: VN→ZH bare-count transfer: Mandarin requires 数词 + 量词 + 名词, and the classifier for 书 (book) is 本. Under uncertainty about the Chinese classifier, learners drop it and write the number directly against the noun (三书). Rule zh-missing-classifier-shu inserts 本 between a number and the bare counted noun 书.
fp_risk_note: Low risk. Scoped to the single noun 书 → 本 and fires only when a number (一两三…十) directly precedes 书. Abstains when a classifier is already present (三本书) and on compounds where 书 is not the counted head (图书馆, 书店, 书法) — those either lack number adjacency or are blocked by the tail lookahead.

positive.notes: 三书 → 三本书 (insert 本).
五书 → 五本书 (insert 本).
两书 → 两本书 (insert 本; 两 already correct so only the classifier rule fires).

negative.notes: Classifier 本 already present — must not double-insert, must abstain.
No number before 书 (看书 = 'read books', generic) — must abstain.
图书馆 (library) — 书 is inside a compound, preceded by 图 not a number, must abstain.
